hooks.command: bash -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && branch=$(git branch --show-current) && case "$branch" in develop-uilayout|develop-uilayout-revise) if [ -n "$(git status --short)" ]; then git add -A && msg=$(git diff --cached --name-only | head -4 | tr "\n" " " | xargs) && git commit -m "auto: ${msg:-update}" && git push origin "$branch"; fi ;; esac'
